title: Make bounty submissions idempotent under concurrency
author: 0xD7AFdc66e0C1Cca76Aca8537f30d10a324E246f1
reproduction: git clone https://github.com/Wisnuajie923/imdworks-idempotent-submissions.git && cd imdworks-idempotent-submissions && git checkout c87aa3769c4de1ab0a7724074995668aa2fd2acb && python3 run_tests.py
limitations: One creator-selected winner; submission is not a reward.
Synthetic local-only benchmark, not a production API or live LLM robustness claim.
No real credentials or wallets in artifact; no blockchain, transfer, approval or withdrawal is part of replay.
No real authentication; synthetic wallet labels and disruptive test fault headers are trusted on loopback.
Scheduling, race winners, ports, PIDs, durations and response ordering vary. Stable invariants, not identical trace bytes, are promised.
SQLite connections currently rely on delayed garbage collection for close; bounded fixtures passed, but production resource guarantees are not made.
Duplicate JSON properties use last-key-wins parsing before validation/hash. Original TDD capture-history limitations are documented.
explanation: SQLite UNIQUE(bounty,wallet), BEGIN IMMEDIATE, optimistic versions and reviewed-record triggers preserve logical state. Status/body and mutation commit atomically under a canonical-payload idempotency hash. Real barrier-started HTTP clients and lost-socket/SIGKILL checkpoint recovery tests demonstrate successful bounded workload and the deliberately naive duplicate-row failure.
